title: Portal Mend — Free HubSpot Health Audit | Jon Martin
description: Portal Mend scores your HubSpot portal and gives you a 90-day fix plan. Your first audit is free. Nothing changes in your portal unless you approve it.
heroTitle: Know what's wrong in your HubSpot portal. Then fix it.
subhead: AI is the lens. The standard is mine: the best practices and the problems I've seen over 11 years across B2B SaaS, B2B services, custom manufacturing, and the companies that work inside and on top of HubSpot. Portal Mend turns that into a scored report and a 90-day plan. Nothing changes in your portal unless you approve it. Fixer is part of that same install: it applies the cleanup items you approve, and shows you every change before it happens.
offerStatement: Nothing changes in your portal unless you approve it. Fixes are optional, and you see every change first.
whoParagraphs: HubSpot admins at smaller companies who inherited the portal, or run it next to another job, and want a straight answer on what needs attention.
Agencies and consultants who manage HubSpot for clients. The first audit for each portal is free, so run it on a client portal before you scope the work.
checks: Data model: unused and duplicate-looking properties, custom objects, association labels.
Pipelines: your deal and ticket stages.
Data quality: how complete the key fields are on contacts, companies, deals and tickets. It uses counts, not copies of your records.
People and access: owners, roles, super admins, and paid seats nobody has used in 90 days.
Marketing and automation: lists, forms, emails and workflows, if your plan includes them.
Security and limits: login activity, an audit-log summary, and account limits.
checksConvergence: 51 automated checks, ending in a plan for the first 30, 60 and 90 days. The tests aren't generic. They're the patterns I've learned to look for over 11 years, run through automation.
fixerHeading: The audit scans and reports. Fixer makes changes, and only what you approve.
auditPoints: Scans your settings and counts records.
Never creates, changes or deletes anything.
Gives you a scored report and a 90-day plan.
fixerPoints: Re-reads the portal and shows a dry-run preview of every change.
You approve it, then it applies, and you can undo.
Fixer covers a short, published list of fixes.
fixerNote: One HubSpot app: Portal Mend, with the audit and Fixer built in. Not made or endorsed by HubSpot.
startBody: It's free for your first portal and starts with one install. Want it to keep watching? Watch reruns the audit every month, or every week, and emails you the report. Fixer is on that same install when you want approved cleanup applied.
